base_parse_rule_or_constraint: Strict lower snake case: uncompressed snappy gzip brotli lz4 lz4_raw zstd. lz4 is deprecated Hadoop framing; not equivalent to lz4_raw.
Integer alongside codec in same object. gzip 0..9 (implicit 6); brotli 0..11 (implicit 1); zstd 1..22 (implicit 1). Other codecs reject levels.

plain (all); rle (BOOLEAN); delta_binary_packed (INT32/INT64); delta_length_byte_array (BYTE_ARRAY); delta_byte_array (BYTE_ARRAY/FIXED_LEN_BYTE_ARRAY); byte_stream_split (INT32/INT64/FLOAT/DOUBLE/FIXED_LEN_BYTE_ARRAY). With dictionary enabled this is a fallback, not a dictionary encoding selector.
Use dictionary_enabled=true. Upstream set_encoding explicitly panics for a dictionary encoding. Dictionary pages and physical footer encodings, not a forced fallback token, prove exercise.
JSON boolean; an omitted leaf inherits the writer/layout policy.

Boolean; exercise requires page statistics.
Boolean. A leaf-level false overrides a global filter. Explicit false plus FPP/NDV in the same object is an error.

Finite positive number. Requires compressed V2 pages for an effect.
Strict v1/v2 (not 1.0/2.0). Omit to inherit. Does not fix every column's actual value encoding.

Positive integer rows; separate from byte limit.

Boolean. False requires no effective leaf using page statistics. There is no separate offset-index truncation in Parquet 58.4.0: offsets are page locations, not min/max values.
Positive integer byte cap. JSON null means inherit under Option<usize>; it cannot explicitly disable truncation (upstream None).
Positive integer byte cap for min/max stats. Cannot explicitly disable truncation.
List of path plus boolean descending/nulls_first; nonempty metadata must match the actual verified order. Do not inject invented order.

Creation only. Array of <=256 unique 1..1024-byte dotted ASCII alphanumeric/underscore primitive leaf paths checked against schema. [] sets indexed-count=0; nonempty list sets named columns. Existing metadata must match; numRecords survives even when skipping statistics are disabled.
Base can set zero via [] but has no positive-N or all-columns (-1) count selector. A count mode must reject a simultaneous explicit list and any existing metadata overriding that count.
Upstream AfterRowGroup (default) / End; affects memory and locality only on files with a Bloom filter.

Base descriptor honors API-supplied properties only; no JSON knob. Coercion can change physical type/path or lose precision. Verify table schema and round-trip rather than counting an invalid write as performance.

Upstream CDC min_chunk_size>0, max_chunk_size>min, norm_level i32. Requires additional range/overflow validation before hashing. Only sequential ArrowWriter preserves state; existing parallel implementations reject it.
Boolean default false: true suppresses the embedded Arrow schema. Must preserve codec declarations and Delta schema; non-equivalent Arrow types require round-trip gating.
Root element name; no encoding algorithm changes. Any future override must preserve physical schema and may only be credited after a footer verifies it.
A precomputed schema descriptor is an implementation optimization, not arbitrary JSON. Delta's physical schema and column mapping are authoritative.
Producer identity, Arrow schema and codec-evidence keys are owned metadata; arbitrary caller-supplied values could falsify evidence. Not encoding or compression selectors.
Not requested by the collector crate's Parquet features; secrets, key management and Delta reader compatibility are separate concerns, not plaintext sweep controls.
backward_compatible_lz4, read_bloom_filter and read_page_statistics are ReaderProperties options, not outputs of the writer.
